title: Creative Connector Interface

list_assets.description: Assets are addressed by opaque assetref handles and listed by kind in deterministic reference order.
list_assets.claim_boundary: No provider asset library is enumerated locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

metadata.description: Metadata is derived locally and redacts the asset reference; rights diagnostics travel with the metadata.
metadata.claim_boundary: No provider metadata record is fetched or trusted. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

rights.description: Rights are validated for a known licence, a named holder, and non-expiry; an unknown licence denies by default.
rights.claim_boundary: No legal clearance is asserted; licence interpretation is the operator's responsibility. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

import.description: Import is denied without a known asset, an explicitly declared source, and valid rights.
import.claim_boundary: No asset bytes are transferred from a provider. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

export_when_granted.description: Export requires export scope, satisfied attribution obligations, and commercial rights for a commercial destination.
export_when_granted.claim_boundary: No file is written to an external destination. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

transform_when_granted.description: Transformation requires transform scope and derivative rights; recorded lineage is append-only and duplicate steps are rejected.
transform_when_granted.claim_boundary: No image, audio, or video processing is executed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health.description: Health reports unavailable, degraded, or ok deterministically from caller-supplied local signals.
health.claim_boundary: Health is computed from local signals, not a live provider probe. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local creative connector interface contract, not a live asset client.
No asset bytes, provider asset identifier, or licence key is stored or returned.
Live asset enumeration, byte transfer, rendering, and rights clearance remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
